item.title: [Message Center] MC1558114 Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Unified RBAC support for App Governance to manage NHIs
item.description:
Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will support unified Defender XDR RBAC in public preview starting late November 2026, enabling delegated, least-privilege access for managing Non-Human Identities. Administrators can assign custom roles for viewing, policy, and service management, with rollout completing by mid-January 2027.
